title: 単独足場ベイ
description: スクリュージャッキ、支柱、接続された水平材と斜材、木製足場板、幅木、上部手すりと側面はしごを持つ一区画。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A single scaffold bay with screw jacks, hollow standards, connected ledgers and braces, timber deck, toe boards, full upper rails and an end ladder. Static visual model, not a load-rated or safety-certified scaffold. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
